display.purpose: Hero headline only. One per page. The architectural statement.

headline.purpose: Section headings. One per section. Bold, compressed, authoritative.

body.purpose: All prose and numerical data. Mono by design — analytical register, not developer signal.

label.purpose: Sparingly as section eyebrows in teal. Not above every section.

shadows.name: floating-card
shadows.purpose: Hero product mockup card — the deepest shadow in the system. Earned by being the page's focal point.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive cards on hover. Appears as a state response, never at rest.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for button and link state transitions.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal for section content. Always progressive enhancement — content visible without the class.

motion.name: ticker
motion.purpose: Horizontal commodity index ticker. Paused on prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: 3d-tilt
motion.purpose: Hero mockup card 3D tilt removal on hover. Ease-out-quint.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-intent CTA. One per section. Inverts on hover — teal text on transparent bg — revealing the brand color underneath.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease; border: 1px solid #00A99D; background: #00A99D; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: transparent; color: #00A99D; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00A99D; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Primary Button Large
components.description: Hero and section-level CTAs. Same invert behaviour at larger padding.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-lg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 30px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease; border: 1px solid #00A99D; background: #00A99D; color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary-lg:hover { background: transparent; color: #00A99D; } .ds-btn-primary-lg:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00A99D; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Pairs with a primary button. Muted by default, darkens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 11px 22px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease; border: 1px solid #d6dde4; background: transparent; color: #4a4a4a; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #666; color: #333; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00A99D; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
CostAdvisor's visual language is a precision instrument on a clean desk — not a dashboard, not a startup pitch, not a Bloomberg terminal cosplay. It is the kind of tool a seasoned Category Manager trusts because it does not try to impress: it delivers.

The canonical theme is StaminaChem light — a cool near-white background (#f5f7fa) with a committed teal accent (#00A99D). The palette is restrained everywhere except at the accent: one saturated color, one role, one voice.

The typeface choice is the most distinctive decision in the system: JetBrains Mono as the body font. Mono type brings the right register — every character has the same width, tables line up, numbers stack cleanly. Syne at 800 weight provides the display muscle that stops the page from reading as a spreadsheet.
keyCharacteristics: Cool near-white background with a single committed teal accent
JetBrains Mono for all body copy and data labels — analytical register, not developer signal
Syne 800 for display and headlines only — maximum contrast with the mono body
Flat-by-default surfaces with subtle shadow reserved for floating elements
Section padding at 96px — deliberate breathing room
Reduced-motion-first animation philosophy: all motion is progressive enhancement
Four theme variants; StaminaChem light is the canonical brand expression

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: The primary teal (#00A99D) carries exactly one role on any given view: either it is the button, or it is the label, or it is the chart line — never all three competing at once. The accent is rare; its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Red (#d64545) means the supplier is charging more than they should. Green/teal means the buyer has leverage. These colors are not decorative — they carry analytical meaning. Never use danger red for a decorative hover state.

rules.name: The Category Palette Rule
rules.body: The 7 commodity category colors are reserved exclusively for commodity category identification in charts and data labels. They do not appear in UI chrome.

rules.name: The Mono-as-Analytical-Register Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is not chosen because this is a developer tool. It is chosen because the users are analysts who work with numbers. Every data value uses mono. This should never be swapped out for a humanist sans 'to feel more approachable.'

rules.name: The One Display Family Rule
rules.body: Syne appears only at headline sizes (17px and above, weight 700+). Body copy, labels, and data labels are always mono. There are exactly two families in this system — never a third.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A card with a shadow at rest signals 'this can be picked up' — use it only when the card is truly interactive. Information cards are not interactive cards; they are flat.

rules.name: The One Glass Rule
rules.body: Backdrop-filter glass is used in exactly one place: the sticky navigation bar. Applying it to section backgrounds or decorative panels is the AI-hype pattern this system explicitly rejects.

dos: Do use #00A99D (primary teal) for exactly one UI role per view — its rarity is its authority.
Do use JetBrains Mono for all numerical data, index values, dates, and data labels.
Do use text-wrap: balance on all Syne headlines to prevent orphans at narrow viewports.
Do keep the body background on the cool side (#f5f7fa, not warm/cream).
Do use prefers-reduced-motion: reduce to kill all animations and show content instantly.
Do reserve #d64545 (danger red) for analytically negative signals only.
Do maintain 96px vertical section padding throughout the page.
Do use perspective(900px) 3D tilt on the hero mockup card, removed on hover.
donts: Don't use purple gradients, glowing neon, or neon-on-dark color combinations.
Don't use particle backgrounds, animated mesh blobs, 'powered by AI' hero badges, or glassmorphism on section backgrounds.
Don't use warm-neutral backgrounds (cream, sand, beige, linen, parchment).
Don't add border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient fill).
Don't repeat the section eyebrow label above every section heading.
Don't use a sans-serif font for body copy or data labels.
Don't apply box-shadow to cards at rest — shadow is a state response, not a default treatment.
Don't use the 7 commodity category colors for interactive UI states or section backgrounds.
